comments.author: Kossmynn
comments.body: The correct ingredients for this dress are: 30x Lace, 40x Satin, 20x SUEDE (not 2x Leather!), r15 sewing+ Adept of 17.4 Chrono Title both needed.

comments.author: ThatOneGuy
comments.body: And if you have R15 or higher sewing (equipment boosts work too!), the above recipe also shows up under Aide Production: Sewing, and requires the exact same ingredients/title. Only an Aide with R15 Sewing can make the recipe, of course... but it's nice to know, just the same!
